title: net.icelander.utv component diagram
description: One package, grouped by responsibility. The typed values sit on top; every typed operation goes through the Typed bridge to the JSON-layer functions, which decode values with the internal Civil, Instants and Rational helpers. Structural validation is the gate every operation passes first.

components.name: Typed values
components.responsibility: CivilDate, CivilYearMonth, CivilTime, CivilDateTime, FixedOffsetDateTime, ZonedIntent, Instant, Period, PosixSeconds, ElapsedSeconds and Interval with Bound, under the sealed TemporalValue: valid by construction, immutable, text form and JSON at the edges.

components.name: Outcomes and policies
components.responsibility: Outcome<T> and its five cases, OutcomeException, Diagnostic and Status; the MonthEnd, Gap, Overlap and ResolutionPolicy policies; Truth, Ordering and Weekday.

components.name: Zone rules and context
components.responsibility: ZoneRules (loaded by the caller), RuleBundle (the parsed bundle and its validity window) and TemporalContext, which holds the rules for resolve, inZone and compare.

components.name: Typed bridge (Typed.java)
components.responsibility: Turns JSON-layer results into Outcomes or plain values, decodes JSON into typed values and refuses JSON a typed value cannot hold, and formats the text form.

components.name: JSON-layer operations
components.responsibility: Values (builders), Operations (fields, add, compare, daysBetween, posixSecondsBetween), Intervals (contains, overlaps), Zones (resolve, toZone, toOffset) and the UtvResult envelope.

components.name: ISO and text form
components.responsibility: Iso (parseIso, formatIso) and TextForm (parseText, formatText): points, periods and bracket intervals, with the EDTF slash forms on input.

components.name: Structural and Gregorian validation
components.responsibility: Utv (JSON parsing with duplicate-key detection, envelope, version and per-kind checks), KindTable, KindRules and GregorianCivil.

components.name: java.time interop
components.responsibility: JavaTime adapters on JSON values, returning NativeResult; the typed from/to methods call them.

components.name: Exact arithmetic and decoding
components.responsibility: Civil (decoded civil values), Gregorian (day arithmetic on BigInteger years), Rational, Instants, Json (canonical shapes) and Fail (internal control flow that never escapes a public operation).

components.name: java.time (JDK)
components.responsibility: The native types, and the JDK's tz database.

relationships.description: Every operation, parse, fromJson and toString goes through Typed.
Partial operations return Outcome; arithmetic takes MonthEnd, Gap, Overlap or ResolutionPolicy.
ZonedIntent.resolve and Instant.inZone take a TemporalContext.
from and to methods call JavaTime.
Civil.structural and Civil.decode before a typed value is built.
TemporalContext calls Zones.resolve, Zones.toZone and Operations.compare.
Decodes civil values and instants, computes exactly.
Builds canonical values and decodes them to format.
Values.inZone and withOffset; Operations.compare to refuse reversed intervals.
The native types; ZoneId.of and ZonedDateTime.ofStrict in toZonedDateTime.
Civil.structural runs Utv.validateStructural on every operand.
GregorianCivil uses Civil.rangeCode for its codes.
